Explore the UK’s New Towns

# Explore the UK’s New Towns

The New Towns programme was one of the most ambitious town building exercises to ever take place in the UK. Over a 50 year period, 32 New Towns were delivered across the England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland. Today, these New Towns provide homes for 2.8 million people.

## Map of the UK’s New Towns and Garden Cities

Explore the UK’s New Towns and Garden Cities using the map and links below. After clicking the link, you will be taken to a webpage on the New Town or Garden City you want to learn more about.
